title: Melanoma under CAR T-cell therapy with TAM-mediated immunosuppression: model analysis, Bayesian calibration and identifiability (code and data)

creators.name: Rodrigues, Guilherme
creators.affiliation: São Paulo State University (UNESP), Institute of Biosciences, Botucatu, Brazil

description:
Code and data of Chapter 3 of the doctoral thesis Mathematical models to describe tumoral behaviors under treatment regimens (Graduate Program in Biometrics, Institute of Biosciences, São Paulo State University, Botucatu, 2026).

The deposit covers a three-population ordinary differential equation model of cutaneous melanoma under CAR T-cell therapy with tumor-associated macrophages: its equilibria and local asymptotic stability, the Hopf bifurcation driven by the pro-tumoral action of the macrophages, a variance-based global sensitivity analysis (eFAST), the Bayesian calibration against the immunocompetent B16 data of Jilani et al. (2024), the structural identifiability analysis with StructuralIdentifiability.jl, the profile-likelihood analysis of practical identifiability, the Fisher-information comparison of experimental designs, and the computational scenarios built on the calibrated model.

Each folder has a README with its structure, and REPRODUCE.md gives the command that produces each figure and table of the chapter. The MCMC chains are deposited separately because of their size.
